main_claim: Paddy Pimblett says he would love to fight Topuria, has had no talks, lists other possible opponents and hopes to return in December.
note: Pimblett's own news naming Topuria as a wanted opponent ('I'd love to smash his head in'); the Gaethje loss is recap. The 'growing chatter' of a Gaethje rematch has no who, when or where, so I read it as no rumour of substance, but an editor could call it next_fight.

main_claim: Paddy Pimblett says he would love to fight Topuria next, though nobody has spoken to him about it, and names other options.
note: Pimblett's callout ('I'd love to smash his head in') is the article; Topuria's loss and record are recap. The closing line that Jon Anik claimed internal talks of a Gaethje-Topuria rematch is a named rumour: I treated it as a closing-line aside, but it could make fact next_fight and centrality one_of_several.

main_claim: Topuria returned to social media with a video letter to his son Hugo reflecting on his first loss.
note: The article is built on his quoted letter to his son ('Hugo, I've been thinking about you'), which the guide treats as personal_life. An editor could pick health (MMA Fighting's line on facial injuries with no surgery) or no_fact (a reflection); the Gaethje fight is only recalled, so result is no.

main_claim: Daniil Donchenko beat Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision at UFC Paris and then called out Daniel Rodriguez.
note: A round-by-round fight report ending in 'Official decision: Daniil Donchenko defeated Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision'. His callout of Rodriguez is described, not quoted, so he does not speak.

main_claim: Daniel Rodriguez answered Donchenko's post-fight callout with a middle-finger emoji on Instagram.
note: Rodriguez 'responded on Instagram stories by sharing the callout with a middle-finger emoji', a taunt aimed at him; the Soriano win is recap and 'the UFC has not confirmed' means no fight news. The article splits between the two men and the reply is new and aimed at Donchenko, so one_of_several, but half of it is Rodriguez's own background and an editor could say only_mentioned or main_subject.

main_claim: Daniil Donchenko confidently beat Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision at the UFC event in Paris.
note: A fight report with the scorecards (30-27, 30-27, 29-28) and a round-by-round account. His callout of Rodriguez and his earlier wish to fight in Paris are described, not quoted.

main_claim: Paddy Pimblett has no fight booked, has not heard from the UFC, and hopes to return in December.
note: Topuria appears in one sentence: Pimblett 'said he would love to fight him but added that no conversations have taken place'. That is a wish to fight him, so calls_him_out, but it is a mild answer to a question inside Pimblett's own news and could be none_of_these (a speaker talking about his own next fight).
